name: product-pricing-fieldset
title: Product pricing fieldset
description: Price, compare-at price and cost for a product form, with the discount, profit and margin worked out as you type.
docs: value is { price, compareAt, cost } in minor units (4900 is 49.00), with null for a field that is empty; control it with value and onValueChange or start it with defaultValue. Below the three fields the discount ('20% off', with what it saves), the profit and the margin are worked out in whole minor units and divided once at the end, so nothing is rounded before it is calculated. A fact that cannot be known yet says 'Not enough information', a compare-at price below the price is flagged in words under its field, and a margin below zero is shown plainly with a warning icon and 'Selling below cost'. A screen reader hears the discount, the profit and the margin when a field is left. showCost (true by default) turns the cost field and the profit and margin rows off. currency sets the symbol and the decimals, a comma or a point both work, locale writes the amounts and percentages, and labels holds the fixed words. pricing.ts exports pricingOf(), so your server can check the same numbers.
